============================================================================
OmniBuf-Py Benchmark Suite (Python 3.14.5 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: Canonical PeerUpdate (nested submessage, 4 neighbors, arrays, scalars)
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed (PeerUpdate)

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 10,287 ns | 97,208 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (@dataclass) | 17,858 ns | 55,998 | 366 | 1.74x slower |
| protobuf-py | 1,226 ns | 815,916 | 341 | 8.39x faster |
| google.protobuf (upb) | 562 ns | 1,780,638 | 341 | 18.32x faster |
| msgspec | 822 ns | 1,216,075 | 634 | 12.51x faster |
| msgpack | 2,646 ns | 377,864 | 634 | 3.89x faster |
| json (stdlib) | 6,214 ns | 160,933 | 874 | 1.66x faster |

| google.protobuf (upb) | 814 ns | 1,228,140 | 22.90x faster |
| msgspec | 1,560 ns | 641,092 | 11.95x faster |
| msgpack | 3,553 ns | 281,431 | 5.25x faster |
| json (stdlib) | 5,901 ns | 169,456 | 3.16x faster |
